title.en: OpenAI Releases GPT-5.6 Sol/Terra/Luna Under Government-Restricted Access
title.zhHans: OpenAI 发布 GPT-5.6 系列，应白宫要求限制为仅政府批准伙伴可访问

searchSummary.en: OpenAI released GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna on June 26, 2026, but restricted access to ~20 government-approved partners at the White House’s request — the first model shipped under the new frontier AI review framework.
searchSummary.zhHans: OpenAI 于 2026 年 6 月 26 日发布 GPT-5.6 Sol/Terra/Luna，但应白宫要求仅限约 20 家政府批准合作伙伴访问——这是首个在前沿 AI 审查框架下发布的模型。

summary.en: On June 26, 2026, OpenAI unveiled GPT-5.6, its next-generation model family with three variants: Sol (flagship, $5/$30 per M tokens), Terra (balanced, $2.50/$15), and Luna (fast/low-cost, $1/$6). However, at the request of the Trump administration under a June 2 Executive Order establishing voluntary 30-day pre-release government review of frontier AI models, OpenAI restricted initial access to approximately 20 government-approved partner organizations through the API and Codex. GPT-5.6 Sol set new state-of-the-art benchmarks on Terminal-Bench 2.1 (91.91% in ultra mode), surpassing Claude Mythos 5 (88%). The restricted release marked the first implementation of the EO framework and established a new pattern: frontier AI releases are no longer freely decided by companies alone.
summary.zhHans: 2026年6月26日，OpenAI 发布了 GPT-5.6，其下一代模型家族包括三个变体：Sol（旗舰，$5/$30 per M tokens）、Terra（均衡，$2.50/$15）和 Luna（快速/低价，$1/$6）。然而，应特朗普政府根据6月2日行政令提出的要求——该行政令建立了前沿AI模型公开发布前自愿性30天政府审查流程——OpenAI 将初始访问权限限制为仅约20家政府批准的合作伙伴组织，通过 API 和 Codex 提供。GPT-5.6 Sol 在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上以 ultra 模式达到 91.91% 的新 SOTA，超越 Claude Mythos 5 的 88%。此次受限发布标志着 EO 框架的首次实施，并确立了一种新模式：前沿 AI 的发布不再由公司单方面决定。

narrative.en:
On June 26, 2026, OpenAI announced GPT-5.6, its next-generation model family. Unlike previous single-model releases, GPT-5.6 launched as three named tiers: Sol (flagship, $5 input/$30 output per million tokens), Terra (balanced everyday model matching GPT-5.5 at roughly half the cost, $2.50/$15), and Luna (fast and affordable for high-volume routine tasks, $1/$6). Sol introduced two new reasoning modes: 'max' (deeper single-chain reasoning) and 'ultra' (subagent coordination for parallel work), achieving 91.91% on Terminal-Bench 2.1 — surpassing Claude Mythos 5's 88%.

The release was unprecedented in its access restrictions. OpenAI previewed the models and plans with the U.S. government ahead of launch, as part of the framework established by President Trump's June 2 Executive Order 'Promoting Advanced Artificial Intelligence Innovation and Security,' which created a voluntary process for frontier AI developers to give the government up to 30 days to review new models before public release. At the government's request, initial access was limited to approximately 20 trusted partner organizations through the API and Codex — not in ChatGPT. OpenAI emphasized this was a short-term step and planned broader availability 'in the coming weeks,' but did not announce a general availability date.

The GPT-5.6 restricted release followed immediately after the Fable 5/Mythos 5 export ban (June 12) and its subsequent lift (June 30), forming a coherent sequence: the Executive Order on June 2, the Fable 5 ban on June 12, the GPT-5.6 preview under government restriction on June 26, and the Fable 5 unban on June 30. Together, these events established that frontier AI governance had shifted from voluntary corporate self-regulation to active government oversight of model releases.
narrative.zhHans:
2026年6月26日，OpenAI 宣布了其下一代模型家族 GPT-5.6。与以往的单模型发布不同，GPT-5.6 推出了三个命名层级：Sol（旗舰，每百万token $5输入/$30输出）、Terra（均衡日常模型，以约一半成本匹敌 GPT-5.5，$2.50/$15）和 Luna（高容量日常任务快速低价选项，$1/$6）。Sol 引入了两种新的推理模式：'max'（更深的单链推理）和'ultra'（子智能体协调并行工作），在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上达到 91.91%，超越 Claude Mythos 5 的 88%。

此次发布在访问限制上是史无前例的。OpenAI 在发布前向美国政府预览了模型和计划，这是特朗普总统6月2日签署的行政令《促进先进人工智能创新与安全》所建立框架的一部分——该行政令创建了一个自愿流程，前沿 AI 开发者可在公开发布前向政府提供最多30天的模型审查期。应政府要求，初始访问权限通过 API 和 Codex 限制为仅约20家受信任的合作伙伴组织——不在 ChatGPT 中提供。OpenAI 强调这是短期措施，并计划'在未来几周'内扩大可用性，但未公布正式可用日期。

GPT-5.6 受限发布紧随 Fable 5/Mythos 5 出口禁令（6月12日）及其后续解除（6月30日）之后，形成了一个连贯的序列：6月2日行政令 → 6月12日 Fable 5 禁令 → 6月26日 GPT-5.6 政府限制预览 → 6月30日 Fable 5 解禁。共同确立了前沿 AI 治理已从自愿企业自我监管转向政府主动监督模型发布的新格局。

text.en: OpenAI previewed GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna on June 26, 2026, with initial access limited to ~20 government-approved partners at the Trump administration's request.
text.zhHans: OpenAI 于2026年6月26日预览了 GPT-5.6 Sol、Terra 和 Luna，初始访问权限应特朗普政府要求限制为约20家政府批准的合作伙伴。

text.en: The restriction followed from President Trump's June 2, 2026 Executive Order establishing a voluntary 30-day government review window for frontier AI models before public release.
text.zhHans: 该限制源于特朗普总统2026年6月2日的行政令，该行政令建立了前沿AI模型公开发布前30天自愿性政府审查窗口。

text.en: GPT-5.6 Sol achieved 91.91% on Terminal-Bench 2.1 in ultra mode, surpassing Claude Mythos 5's 88% — setting a new state of the art.
text.zhHans: GPT-5.6 Sol 在 ultra 模式下于 Terminal-Bench 2.1 达到 91.91%，超越 Claude Mythos 5 的 88%，创造了新的 SOTA。

text.en: GPT-5.6's restricted release, combined with the Fable 5 export ban and subsequent unban, marked the transition from voluntary corporate AI governance to active government oversight of frontier model releases — a paradigm shift in AI regulation.
text.zhHans: GPT-5.6 的受限发布，结合 Fable 5 出口禁令及其后续解除，标志着 AI 治理从自愿企业自我监管向政府主动监督前沿模型发布的转变——这是 AI 监管的范式转变。

text.en: Critics argued that the government restriction set a concerning precedent: without clear legislative mandate, the executive branch effectively gained veto power over frontier AI releases through informal requests rather than legal processes.
text.zhHans: 批评者认为政府限制开创了一个令人担忧的先例：在没有明确立法授权的情况下，行政分支通过非正式请求而非法律程序，实际上获得了对前沿AI发布的否决权。

text.en: GPT-5.6 is the first model released under the June 2 Executive Order framework, establishing a new norm: frontier AI model releases are subject to government review and approval before public access. This represents a fundamental shift from industry self-governance to government oversight.
text.zhHans: GPT-5.6 是首个在6月2日行政令框架下发布的模型，建立了一个新常态：前沿AI模型的发布在公开访问前需接受政府审查和批准。这代表了从行业自我监管向政府监管的根本转变。

description.en: GPT-5.6 is the first model released under the June 2 Executive Order framework, establishing a new norm: frontier AI model releases are subject to government review and approval before public access. This represents a fundamental shift from industry self-governance to government oversight.

description.en: GPT-5.6 Sol delivered new SOTA benchmarks, particularly on agentic workflows (Terminal-Bench 2.1: 91.91%), while the new ultra reasoning mode introduced subagent-based parallel problem-solving — a genuine architectural innovation.
description.zhHans: GPT-5.6 Sol 在智能体工作流（Terminal-Bench 2.1：91.91%）上创造了新的 SOTA，同时新的 ultra 推理模式引入了基于子智能体的并行问题解决能力——这是真正的架构创新。

description.en: The restricted release pattern (government approval gate for frontier models) creates regulatory uncertainty for the AI industry and could accelerate the shift toward non-US AI ecosystems if US models face persistent access limitations.
description.zhHans: 受限发布模式（前沿模型须经政府批准）为AI行业带来了监管不确定性，如果美国模型持续面临访问限制，可能加速向非美国AI生态系统的转移。
